# Lenny Winnemuller

> Lenny Winnemuller is an Amsterdam-based coach who teaches long-term investing as a skill. He offers a personal 12-month coaching program for people who already know the financial markets and want to build a disciplined, personal long-term investing system. This is education and coaching only: Lenny gives no investment advice and no buy or sell recommendations.

## Free workshop
- Title: Why Great Investors Study More and Trade Less: The 20-Decision Rule
- Date: Thursday 29 October 2026, 19:30 Amsterdam time (14:30 Toronto, 11:30 Vancouver)
- Online and free; registration at https://lennywinnemuller.com/workshop/

## About Lenny
- Based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands
- Graduated with honors in psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specializing in group behavior; also holds a degree in entrepreneurship
- Worked as a professional in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada; now invests independently
- Teaches long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program
- Mission: improve financial education and help people master the skill of long-term investing

## Market updates
- A weekly note for long-term investors on what moved the markets and what it means for long-term investors. No tips, no advice.
- Published weekly at https://lennywinnemuller.com/updates/
- Latest: [Week 42, 2026: CoreWeave, the Gartner warning and rising US inflation](https://lennywinnemuller.com/updates/2026-10-17-coreweave-the-gartner-warning-and-rising-us-inflation/)

## The 12-month coaching program
- Personal coaching, fully online, for 12 months
- Deliverables: an Investment Policy Statement (rewritten every quarter), a personal investment plan, a crash plan with selling rules, and a decision journal
- Clients practice with a paper portfolio from week 1, with weekly and monthly assignments
- Clients learn how to value businesses and how to defend their investment theses
- Quarters: foundation; understanding businesses; valuation and portfolio; behaviour and independence
- Pricing and the founding offer are presented at the free workshop
